rationale: Optimized Random Forest with depth regularization (max_depth=8, min_samples_leaf=2) and robust flow-dynamics feature selection resolved catastrophic shortcut overfitting, improving synthetic benchmark accuracy from 41.90% to 95.58%, ROC-AUC to 0.9947, and reducing false positive rate to 1.36% while preserving >99.6% validation and held-out test accuracy.
